(Japanese: '''出動！！ポケモンレンジャー''' ''Mobilize!! Pokémon Ranger'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] created by [[Miho Asada]]. It is one of the adaptations of the [[Pokémon Ranger series]] games. It appeared in Comic Land (コミックランド) volume 1 - 12 (April 2006 - March 2007).
